startup_gate.require: Current-container top-level startup-probe success followed by top-level Site started, both after configuration update
startup_gate.reject: Warmup waiting/probing/initialization and historical Details fields

readiness_gate.retryable: Transport/DNS/timeout errors or transient startup502/503 reset streak; never count as success
readiness_gate.stop_immediately: TLS certificate verification error,401/403,wrong identity/revision/release,configuration drift,explicit current startup failure or critical schema/security fault

rollback_success_requires: original flag absent; all unrelated settings and web configuration unchanged; stable original-release/revision health
